newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end quiet afternoon mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end quiet afternoon mixed.

text.p: IMM currency futures finished mixed after a quiet day that featured a strong yen.
September yen futures opened firm, surged near midday to a one-week high of $0.008950, and closed moderately higher.

Traders said a slide in the mark/yen cross dictated yen futures early strength, and later, a wire service story suggesting the Bank of Japan may be inclined to raise Japanese rates extended the upmove.
"People are anticipating a stronger yen," an IMM currency futures trader said. "Mark/yen cross pressure shows that."
Traders pegged $0.009000 as next September yen resistance.
